entries.coverage: Full pre-registered proxy-parameter grid: k in {2,3,4,5,6} x rule in {min, mean, frac_pass} = 15/15 cells, each scored for catch on the frozen planted-45 EN_NOVOWEL hallucination population AND genuine false-reject on a 20-case correct-key EN_MODERN panel. Winning cell (k=5/min) then FROZEN and audited on a DISJOINT held-out surrogate (fresh key seed CICADA3301, disjoint rng offsets): 66 hallucinations + 24 genuine. Conditionals held fixed: key space = correct key (hardest case); decoder relation = exact preset; adjudicator register = EN_NOVOWEL argmax. Language-agnostic held-out recovery (rune-index self-consistency, no plaintext oracle, no English LM) persisted per cell in catch_surface.json (doctrine R3).
entries.not_covered: NC-1 keyskip1-relation catch: the planted 45 are exact-preset overfits; Q4 named the keyskip1 relation axis but this lane did not populate a keyskip1 hallucination population, so catch along that axis is unmeasured. NC-2 registers other than EN_NOVOWEL: catch on Latin/Welsh/OE-register hallucinations not measured (EN_NOVOWEL is the FOUND-ERROR's register). NC-3 non-fold proxy families: a longer decrypt head than the 24-32 rune head that capped R20 P1's hard registers, a per-register fold bar, or a learned self-consistency gate could still reach 0.90; the disjoint-fold family alone is bounded here at 0.818 (genuine-safe, held-out) to 0.867 (genuine-unsafe ceiling). NC-4 the seal is a proxy-power bound, not a claim that any specific LP2 candidate is or is not a solve.
entries.reopens_if: Any of: (a) a non-fold no-oracle proxy family (longer decrypt head, per-register fold bar, learned self-consistency) reaches >=0.90 catch with <=0.10 genuine false-reject on a held-out surrogate -- that would seal the gate the fold family could not; (b) a keyskip1-relation hallucination population is planted and changes the catch surface along the relation axis; (c) an oracle becomes available for a specific candidate (then STRICT mode's 45/45 catch applies and flagged-for-oracle is resolvable). Until sealed, Round 21 sweeps carry bar-clearing survivors as flagged-for-oracle, never auto-certified.
entries.notes: OPERATIVE CONSEQUENCE for Round 21: the no-oracle held-out gate is provably leaky at the class (exact, EN_NOVOWEL, correct key). The disjoint-fold strengthening lifts real-mode catch from the single-cut 0.33 to 0.80-0.87 -- a large, generalising improvement -- but not to the 0.90 seal, and its genuine-safe cell drops false-reject discipline on held-out data (0.00 -> 0.167). Therefore any bar-clearing real-mode survivor from Round 21's high-prior sweeps is FLAGGED-FOR-ORACLE, not auto-certified as a solve. Coverage x power lane bounds are unaffected; only auto-HIT-calling is withheld. tests/validate.py PASSES 5/5 before and after; SWEEPROW/3 field order untouched (the fold proxy is a drop-in behind recovery_source).

entries.hypothesis: P2 (R20) proved the n_skips statistic has zero page-window (L<=400) power and 0.999 full-book (L=12956) power; the length L at which it crosses over from non-separating to separating was UNMEASURED (named top-3 in R20 sec7 and sec8.5, and PICKUP-HERE item #4). Sweep a geometric L ladder in (400,12956) at seed 3301, measuring planted-vs-wrong-key n_skips two-sided separation per L against a size-matched null; report the smallest L crossing the pre-registered FPR=0.01.
entries.threshold: Pre-registered in PREREG.md before any sweep: FPR=0.01 two-sided; SEPARATION at L iff correct-key two-sided empirical p <= 0.01 against a size-matched wrong-key null (M=300) at that L AND plant recovery >= 0.90; CROSSOVER L* = smallest ladder L that separates and stays separated for all larger measured L. Positive control = plant recovery >= 0.90 at every L. Q1-gate: L=400 must NOT separate and L=12956 MUST separate (recovery >=0.99) before intermediate Ls are trusted (Q5 kill otherwise). No fixed score bar; exact discrete tail, never a Gumbel bar (I3 10.1b).
entries.control_detail: Plant recovery >= 0.998 at EVERY ladder L on the keyskip1-exact cells (1.000 through L=2400; 0.999-0.998 at L=3600-12956). Instrument recovers its own planted rejection-loop footprint everywhere, so non-separation at L<6000 is a real power bound, not unvalidated silence. Q1-gate PASSED: L=400 no-sep (correct 6 vs null mean 8.87, p2=0.520) reproduces R20's ~0.21-class no-separation; L=12956 clean right-tail sep (correct 418 vs null mean 296.99, p2=0.000, recovery 0.999) reproduces R20's 418-vs-~300 full-book control. R's A-iv decoupling respected: separation gated on recovery>=0.90 AND p<=FPR, never on score.
entries.result: CROSSOVER FOUND (exact channel). On the keyskip1-exact relation the n_skips statistic crosses from non-separating to separating between L=3600 and L=6000; CROSSOVER L* = 6000 (smallest ladder point clearing FPR=0.01 two-sided, holds at 9000 and 12956). Correct-key footprint grows ~linearly (6->418) while wrong-key fabrication grows sublinearly (8.9->297): correct overtakes null MEAN at L~1000-1200 but clears the 1% right TAIL (q99) only at L=6000. Two-sided p: 0.52/1.04/0.45/0.40/0.19/0.19/0.27 (no-sep) at L=400..3600, then 0.000 at L=6000/9000/12956. IMPLICATION: any future concatenated-page / whole-book n_skips adjudication must use a window >= ~6000 runes (~11-12 pages) before n_skips ALONE is a valid discriminator under the exact decoder; below that, combine with P3a panel-max (PICKUP-HERE #4) or enlarge the window.
entries.coverage: Sequence-LENGTH coverage (NOT key space): 10-point geometric ladder L in {400,600,900,1200,1600,2400,3600,6000,9000,12956}, seed 3301, order-preserving, size-matched wrong-key null M=300 per L with the full exact discrete histogram persisted. Brackets the entire (400,12956) gap that R20 left UNMEASURED. Power measured as plant recovery (>=0.998 all L) x correct-key separation p per L, over two decoder channels (keyskip1, drift) and (final stages) the skip_by_two mechanism + a 5-register invariance panel at the L=6000 neighbourhood.
entries.reproduce: cd liber-primus/analysis/round21/L2-nskips-crossover-length && python3 crossover.py  (reuses ../../round20/P2/nskips_lib.py; seed 3301; Q1-gate runs first as the Q5 kill checkpoint, then the ladder; writes nskips_crossover.json incrementally).
entries.reopens_if: A cheaper statistic, a longer-per-decode decoder, or a mixed n_skips+panel-max combination lowers the effective crossover below 6000; OR the encipherer's true rejection loop is neither keyskip nor skip_by_two (then its own crossover curve must be measured).
entries.notes: Run COMPLETE (done=true, 34 points, 71 min). THREE-CHANNEL SPLIT, read carefully. (1) keyskip1 exact: honest right-tail-footprint crossover at L*=6000 (holds at 9000/12956; not at <=3600). (2) drift permissive (lam=12 max_free=2): the permissive beam FABRICATES huge skip counts on random wrong keys (wrong-key null mean 32->897 as L grows), so the correct key's genuine small footprint sits in the extreme LEFT tail at EVERY L (p_left=0.000, p2=0.000 from L=400). This 'separates everywhere' under the two-sided test but is a LEFT-tailed ARTIFACT of wrong-key inflation, NOT the right-tail footprint P2/T3 measured -- do NOT read the drift channel as a page-scale n_skips discriminator; crossover.drift|keyskip=400 is this artifact. (3) skip_by_two (R18 L7-B): the beam CANNOT represent this relation -- plant recovery collapses from 0.28 (L=400) to 0.039 (L=12956), never near 0.90, so under the recovery>=0.90 gate skip_by_two NEVER separates and crossover.keyskip1|skip_by_two=None; reported as a SEPARATE curve, never merged. REGISTER-APPROXIMATE crossover (5-register panel @L=6000, all recover >=0.9995): LP1_REAL and OE cross at 6000; LATIN (corr 175, p2=0.020) and EN_HALFVOWEL (corr 179, p2=0.013) cross JUST past 6000; EN_MODERN (corr 144, p2=0.740) footprint much smaller, crossover >>6000. So L*=6000 is the crossover for the LP-relevant registers (LP1_REAL,OE); a conservative universal gate rounds up to ~7000-8000. n_skips carries no plaintext language model; no English scorer gated anything. Doctrine R7: this is a BOUND (a length), not a verdict. | EVIDENCE DETAIL (moved here 2026-08-31 from a malformed string `evidence` field): analysis/round21/L2-nskips-crossover-length/nskips_crossover.json (crossover.keyskip1|keyskip = 6000; per-(L,channel,mechanism,register) discrete histograms, correct/gt n_skips, recovery, two-sided p; reproduced R20 endpoints in q1_gate). RESULTS.md + PREREG.md alongside.

entries.hypothesis: A public dated random source (NIST Randomness Beacon v1 / dated block headers) is the OTP, JOINED to each page by that page's own PGP signature CREATION TIME -- a join key R17-PUBLIC-PAD never used (it swept beacon/blockchain as undated contiguous offsets only). Reduced-scope C8 survivor of Round-24 Gate-#1; needs a bounded external fetch, post-2013-09 pages only.
entries.verdict: UNAVAILABLE by premise. Step 0 shows the join key does not exist for the decrypt target: enumerating every PGP-signed Cicada artifact in data/scream314_lp.md yields exactly 8 clearsigned blocks (all key 7A35090F, GnuPG 1.4.11, all Jan-2014), and ALL 8 sign intro/index PROSE or JPEG-hash wrappers -- NONE of the unsolved LP2 runic ciphertext pages (data/krisyotam_runes.txt, 0-54) carries any PGP signature. The runic pages were distributed as a book/PDF with no per-page timestamp to index a dated pad by. Premise-2 (dates covered) PASSES -- all 8 timestamps postdate NIST Beacon genesis 2013-09-05 and the v1 legacy REST endpoint serves the real 2014 records -- but is MOOT. No timestamp->page mapping was fabricated. The PIPELINE was still built and CONTROL-VALIDATED, and the fullest defensible steelman probe returned a clean control-validated null.

RIGHT date: recovery 1.000, held-out 1.000, pmax 29.44 vs bar 4.87, HIT=True. WRONG date (2014-01-19 real pulse): recovery 0.032. WRONG source (seed-3301 pad): recovery 0.032. Two pipeline bugs caught by the control before any verdict: (1) plain-additive encipherment with no filter desyncs the beam to 0.28-0.50; (2) tiling a single 512-bit pulse desyncs across the tile boundary. Both fixed.

entries.hypothesis: A cheap, skip-aware, MULTI-REGISTER prefilter (sieve) can screen a PRNG keyspace at >=100x reduction while retaining >=0.90 of true keys per register, making the enumerable 2012-Linux generator families affordable to sweep. Load-bearing precondition for all of Round 20's Phase S.
entries.verdict: INFEASIBLE at the frozen bar -- and a large positive register-repair result alongside. Best simultaneous min(CY-Welsh, EN_HALFVOWEL) survival at >=100x reduction = 0.667 (Wilson-95 upper 0.85 < 0.90, so more n cannot flip it). Reduction was trivially met (median 200-10,000x); SURVIVAL, not reduction, is the binding constraint. The multi-register lever nonetheless REPAIRS C2's English-only blindness: EN_NOVOWEL 0.000->0.800, EN_HALFVOWEL 0.067->0.667, CY-Welsh 0.300->0.733. Trilemma: cheap AND >=0.90-survival AND multi-register -- pick two.
entries.control_detail: Negative control RAND survives 0.000 in every cell (no leak, no manufacture; true-offset median rank ~44,988/200,000); the LP1_REAL recogniser survives 0.933-1.000 at rank 0. Run against real hash-verified Marsaglia physical bytes. The instrument is validated, so INFEASIBLE is a measured bound, not unvalidated silence.
entries.threshold: Frozen in PREREG.md before any screen: PASS iff >=0.90 true-key survival PER REGISTER at >=100x screen reduction. Measured 0.667; not edited after the result.
entries.coverage: Screen-statistic surface over the register panel (LP1_REAL / LATIN / OE / EN_HALFVOWEL / EN_NOVOWEL / CY-Welsh) on 24-32-rune decrypt heads, at reductions spanning 100x-10,000x, against real Marsaglia physical pads. Published in full as survival_surface.json.
not_covered: Decrypt heads longer than 24-32 runes (the signal ceiling that capped the hard registers) -- the most likely direction for a feasible sieve.
Reduction targets below 100x (e.g. 30x), where the published surface may already show >=0.90.
Screen-statistic families other than the per-register z / max-over-9 form.
The drift Stage-B variant HURTS survival here (EN_NOVOWEL 0.833->0.667), reproducing the R19 B-iv permissiveness cost at screen scale.
entries.result: Gate MISSED with margin, so the P-gate did not open. Phase S may run G3 ONLY (the one space enumerable without a sieve). S-PERL / S-TEX are DEFERRED, not merely queued: no affordable sieve exists for them.
entries.reopens_if: A screen statistic reaches >=0.90 survival on Welsh AND half-vowel English at >=100x reduction; OR the coordinator lowers the operating point (30x reduction, or a longer decrypt head) at which survival_surface.json already shows >=0.90 is reachable. STANDING CONDITION from R20-R-REDTEAM (b): any re-enabled sieve must first re-fit the panel-max null on SCREENED wrong keys (~2.5e6 FP inflation otherwise).

entries.hypothesis: The decoder-path statistic n_skips (the rejection-loop footprint) separates a correct key from wrong keys at PAGE-WINDOW length, and can therefore serve as a language-free sieve statistic.
entries.verdict: VALIDATED NEGATIVE as a page-window sieve statistic. Raw n_skips is a FULL-BOOK / long-window discriminator, not a page-window (L<=400) one. At page-window L the planted supp>=0.83 median n_skips falls BELOW the wrong-key q99 in every cost-register cell (L120 {LP1_REAL 2, LATIN 3, OE 4, HALFVOWEL 3} vs q99=9; L400 {14,7,12,14} vs q99=19); best two-sided p = 0.207, far above the FPR 0.01 bar. The frozen Q5 kill fired as written.
entries.control_detail: Plant recovery median 0.992; seed-3301 order-preserving surrogate ratio 0.987 (L120) / 1.002 (L400), inside +/-25%; full-book control (L=12956) correct-key n_skips=418 vs wrong ~300 at recovery 0.999 -- a clean ~118-draw right-tail separation. The statistic works; only its page-window POWER is absent.
entries.threshold: Frozen in PREREG.md: separation at L iff the correct-key n_skips clears the size-matched wrong-key null's q99 at two-sided FPR=0.01, with plant recovery >=0.90.
entries.coverage: Exact discrete-tail null at L in {120, 400, 12956} across the cost-register cells, seed 3301 order-preserving. SWEEPROW/2 wired so n_skips + n_unexplained persist on every future sweep row regardless (doctrine R3), leaving the channel re-adjudicable at any L later.
not_covered: L between 400 and 12956 -- the power crossover length. This was the single measurement a future P1/S lane needed. MEASURED the following round: R21-L2-NSKIPS-CROSSOVER-LENGTH found L* = 6000 on the exact keyskip1 relation.
entries.result: P1 must not lean on n_skips at page-window length. A close-out lane MAY use it as a right-tail screen when adjudicating whole-page / whole-book windows.
entries.reopens_if: A cheaper or longer-window variant of the statistic, or a combined n_skips + panel-max rule, shows page-window separation; or a rejection loop other than keyskip / skip_by_two is proposed, since each carries its own crossover curve.

entries.hypothesis: The Round-19 instrument can be given (a) a directly calibrated panel-max null bar, (b) an evidence-derived seed prior replacing the flat one, and (c) a drift re-baseline establishing transcription robustness.
entries.verdict: PASS on all three. (a) Canonical bar CALIBRATED at M=1e6 (exact/keyskip1): mu=2.3575, beta=0.28653, claim-bar 7.634; correct-key pmax power 1.00 on LP1_REAL / LATIN / OE / EN_HALFVOWEL, wrong-key 0.00, RAND 0.00; G-CAL adopted-bar-on-fresh-null ratio 1.042. Panel-max OUT-RECOVERS the English `en` bar, which is 0.00 on EN_NOVOWEL. (b) 433 ranked seed candidates emitted, rank-1 = 1325734783 (tiers A54/B107/C260/D12), 0/433 round-trip mismatches. (c) GENUINELY NEW: the repaired drift_rec beam is strictly MORE transcription-robust than keyskip1 -- derail 0.00 at every corruption level to k=900, tracking the graceful ideal exactly. This is the question R19 T3 asked and could not answer.

entries.threshold: Frozen: the bar is CALIBRATED iff correct-key pmax power >=0.90 on the four win-condition registers with wrong-key and RAND power 0.00, and the adopted-bar-on-fresh-null ratio is within 20%. Met (1.00 / 0.00 / 0.00, ratio 1.042).
entries.coverage: Panel-max direct null at M=1e6 for the exact/keyskip1 preset; a 433-candidate unix-second seed prior with round-trip verification; a drift derail curve to k=900 substitutions. This is the bar every subsequent round (R21-R25) adjudicates against.

entries.hypothesis: A runnable hit-decision function can gate a sweep on REPRODUCTION rather than score, so that a hallucinating decode which clears the null on score alone can never be certified a solve.
entries.verdict: SHIPPED, and its strict-mode guard PASSED. hitfn20.is_hit(decode) returns True only when all three hold: (1) pmax >= panelmax20.panelmax_bar (exact preset, N=1e6 -> 7.634; never -5.5, never a k_eff); (2) rune-INDEX recovery >= 0.90 from the driftbeam decode path, never from score; (3) the key attributed on the first 1/4 of the page reproduces recovery >= 0.90 on the held-out 3/4. Emits SWEEPROW/3 (18 fields), header_v3 and validate_row_v3, which raises on an inconsistent hit=True row. Shipping it cleared the round's red-team HALT (defect d).
entries.control_detail: Hallucination guard (out_guard.json): a FAKE -- real vowel-dropped English, correct key, exact preset -- genuinely CLEARS the panel-max bar on pmax (9.29 >= 7.634, so this is a real hallucination test rather than a null failure) yet has true rune-index recovery 0.438 and held-out self-consistency 0.833; is_hit REJECTS it in BOTH strict and real/no-oracle mode. A genuine decode (correct key, English, exact: pmax 26.41, recovery 1.000, held-out 1.000) is ACCEPTED in both. Tests 5/5 HITFN + 4/4 P3 green.
entries.threshold: Frozen three-clause gate: pmax >= panelmax_bar(preset, N) AND rune-index recovery >= 0.90 AND held-out-3/4 recovery >= 0.90. Score alone is never a HIT.
entries.coverage: The gate every sweep from Round 20's Phase S onward routes through: R20 S-G3 / S-RESCOPE, R21 L3, R22 C, R24 C2 / C2-EXT, R25 compute-tail.
not_covered: The REAL-MODE (no-oracle) clause-3 proxy is LEAKY -- and it is the only mode a real LP2 candidate can be judged in. It caught 15/45 (33%) EN_NOVOWEL hallucinations at ship time (found by R20 S-RESCOPE's audit, SYNTHESIS 8.4); the disjoint-fold strengthening attempted in R21-L1 reached only 0.80 and was KILLED. See R21-L1-SEAL.
EN_NOVOWEL clears the bar at recovery 0.84 (exact) / 0.26 (drift), both < 0.90, so that register is detection-only.
entries.result: Score alone can no longer certify a hallucinating decode in strict mode. In real mode a bar-clearing survivor is FLAGGED-FOR-ORACLE, never auto-certified -- standing since R21-L1.
entries.reopens_if: A non-fold no-oracle proxy reaches >=0.90 catch at <=0.10 false-reject on the EN_NOVOWEL hallucination population -- a longer decrypt head, a per-register fold bar, or a learned self-consistency gate. Until then HIT auto-certification stays withheld.

entries.hypothesis: Standing red-team lane (doctrine R6). Target: Round 20's own claims -- does P1 manufacture survival, is Phase S a silent re-run, does the sieve interact with the panel-max null, and can a row be certified on score alone?
entries.verdict: MIXED -- two NO-ERROR-FOUND, two FOUND-ERROR. (a) structured wrong-key null -> NO-ERROR-FOUND: P1 does not leak; structured-text survival is 0.000, the RAND floor, on all 5 registers, while true-key survival transfers at 0.67-0.92. (c) not-a-re-run -> NO-ERROR-FOUND: ZERO key-space decodes were ever scored AT POWER for G1/G2/G3/G4/R16-PRNG; the one prior full-2^32 sweep was rigid + English-4gram + a fixed -12.5 bar, i.e. zero power. (b) FOUND-ERROR (latent): P1's screen statistic and P3a's adjudication statistic are the SAME max-over-9 family, and the P3a bar is fitted on FRESH UNSCREENED wrong keys -- on the SCREENED survivor population the per-decode FP is 0.025 (5/200) against a nominal 1.0e-8, a ~2.5e6 inflation. (d) FOUND-ERROR (blocking at the time): no runnable recovery gate existed on the hit path, so an S-lane could have certified a hallucinating decode on score alone. Phase S was HALTED until one shipped.
entries.control_detail: The audit instrument separates a leaking screen from a sound one: structured wrong-key survival measured at the RAND floor (0.000) while true-key survival transfers at 0.67-0.92 through the same cells.
entries.threshold: Pre-registered per sub-attack. Verdicts are FOUND-ERROR / NO-ERROR-FOUND, never 'confirmed' (doctrine R6). The lane carries abort authority over Phase S.
entries.coverage: Four pre-registered sub-attacks on Round 20's own reasoning, run before Phase S released.
not_covered: Sub-attack (b) is LATENT only because P1 is INFEASIBLE and the sieve is therefore not deployed. It binds the moment any screened sweep runs.
entries.result: Defect (d) was CLEARED in-round by R20-HITFN-RECOVERY-GATE. Defect (b) STANDS as a binding condition on any future screened sweep; R21-L5 re-checked it and confirmed Round 21's unscreened sweeps did not re-introduce it.
entries.reopens_if: STANDING CONDITION: do NOT re-enable a P1-style sieve without first re-fitting the panel-max null on the SCREENED wrong-key population, or applying the measured ~2.5e6 correction. Otherwise sweep unscreened, or carry the inflation as an explicit conditional.

entries.hypothesis: A-03 falsifier, the one live autokey reopener: could physical haplography -- a scribe merging duplicated runes -- have destroyed an autokey signature that is really present in LP2?
entries.verdict: NO-ERROR-FOUND, power 1.00. The decisive fact is STRUCTURAL: reversing haplography (re-inserting a duplicated rune) touches ONLY the d=0 difference diagonal, and the 28 nonzero diagonals that carry the autokey signature are LITERALLY INVARIANT under any number of merges. Observed LP2 diagonal-lumpiness cv = 0.061; a super-physical adversary reaches only cv = 0.0656 at K=20, which is 6.1x below the 0.40 autokey band, and never reaches it through K=40.
entries.control_detail: The positive control recovers autokey through K=20 merges with cv separation 0.784 against a 0.15 bar: the instrument sees an autokey signature that survives merging, so its silence on LP2 is a real bound.
entries.threshold: Frozen: autokey is reopened iff an adversarial merge schedule lifts diagonal-lumpiness cv into the 0.40 autokey band. Max reached was 0.0656 at K=20, and never through K=40.
entries.coverage: Merge schedules to K=40 under a super-physical adversary -- more merges than any plausible scribe -- measured on the real LP2 diagonals.
not_covered: Merge mechanisms that alter the NONZERO diagonals. None has been proposed, and one would contradict R16's d=0-only surplus audit.
entries.result: The autokey / ciphertext-feedback refutation is HARDENED, and its one live reopener is closed.
entries.reopens_if: Someone proposes a merge (or other transcription) mechanism that alters the nonzero difference diagonals and shows it can lift cv into the 0.40 band.
